svg.title: Working principles
svg.desc: Architecture before code. Domain boundaries first; the framework is an implementation detail, not the design. Ship it, then observe it. Software that reaches production and tells you how it's doing beats software that's elegant on a branch. AI to code faster — not to think less. Agentic workflows for the repetitive part, human judgement for the decisions that cost money later. Detail is not decoration. The same care that goes into an API contract goes into a keyboard's switch feel and a README's spacing.
